m

Empieza por una tarea que te quite trabajo.
Tu rúbrica está en una hoja de cálculo. Llévala a Moodle.
La IA propone comentarios. La nota la decides tú.

Encuentra tu punto de partida.

findings.message: 1 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 1440px: "Tu IA, trabajando en Moodle." → 3 lines (5 words, 86.4px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 36px or less.

findings.message: 1 large-set statement(s) run past 3 lines at 1440px: "Prepara una unidad sobre uso responsable…" → 6 lines at 32px
findings.fix: A statement set large is about 30 words. Cut it, or set the rest as ordinary body text.

findings.message: 1 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "Un ejemplo de encargo docente" above "Prepara una unidad sobre uso responsable"
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.

findings.message: 6 box-shadow(s) on elements at rest: a.skip-link → rgba(36, 38, 36, 0.08) 0px 10px 28px 0px | a.network-node.node-rubrics → rgba(36, 38, 36, 0.08) 0px 10px 28px 0px | a.network-node.node-analyze → rgba(36, 38, 36, 0.08) 0px 10px 28px 0px
findings.fix: Remove. Separate surfaces with a tone step or space. Shadows are for things that really float (menus, dialogs, sticky bars).

findings.message: 27 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): header.site-header 1440px | div.container.hero-principles 1360px | li 600px | li 600px
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.
Prefer a filled surface or no box.

findings.message: 2 row(s) of identical cards each topped with a small icon (3, 3 cards).
findings.fix: Replace with one composed section from the direction: a narrative split, a list set in large type, or real imagery per item.
Use the drawn palette. If you want warmth, take a low-chroma stone or bone, not a yellow cream.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: The running text is a soft grey on its ground (5.1:1).
findings.fix: Set body copy in the full ink (7:1 or more). Keep the muted ink for secondary notes; pages read thin and unfinished when everything is grey.

findings.message: Only 0 picture(s) on the page (0 photographs, footage or raster images, 0 interface fragments). Drawings in SVG do not count.
findings.fix: Find real pictures of the subject's world with scripts/assets.mjs (photographs, archival images, maps, engravings, footage), download them to assets/ and give them room: a hero picture, one per section that has a subject, a full-width band. At least four, usually six to twelve.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: Longest paragraph runs about 92 characters per line.

findings.fix: Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: Only 1 element(s) moved while the page loaded and scrolled.
findings.fix: Build the motion layer (SKILL.md step 9, references/motion.md): the signature move, an entrance for the parts of every section, feedback on every control, and one moving picture. Transform and opacity only, with a reduced-motion fallback.
